# JUDO Tatami JSL

> Model transformation engine that converts JSL (JUDO Specification Language) source files into runtime-ready target models (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, Liquibase, Expression, Keycloak) for the JUDO platform.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 (multi-module, 6 modules)
- Built on Eclipse Epsilon 2.8.0 (ETL/EOL model-to-model transformations) and Eclipse EMF (Ecore metamodeling)
- Transforms `.jsl` files through a pipeline: JSL → PSM → ASM → RDBMS → Liquibase, JSL → UI, ASM → Expression/Keycloak
- Packaged as a Maven plugin (`default-model-workflow` goal) for build-time code generation
- Multi-dialect database support (PostgreSQL, HSQLDB)
- Part of the JUDO ecosystem (depends on judo-meta-* metamodels and judo-tatami-core workflow infrastructure)
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, transformation pipeline diagram, quick start guide
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Full developer guide with build commands, architecture, module descriptions, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines and development setup
- [Workflow Maven Plugin Reference](docs/pages/judo-tatami-jsl-workflow-maven-plugin.md): Full parameter reference and usage examples for the Maven plugin

## Modules — Transformation

- [judo-tatami-jsl-jsl2psm/pom.xml](judo-tatami-jsl-jsl2psm/pom.xml): JSL to Platform Specific Model (PSM) transformation using Epsilon ETL; contains ~60 EOL operation scripts
- [judo-tatami-jsl-jsl2ui/pom.xml](judo-tatami-jsl-jsl2ui/pom.xml): JSL to UI model transformation using Epsilon ETL; contains ~40 EOL operation scripts

## Modules — Orchestration

- [judo-tatami-jsl-workflow/pom.xml](judo-tatami-jsl-workflow/pom.xml): Core workflow orchestration; configures and runs the full transformation pipeline with parallel execution support
- [judo-tatami-jsl-workflow-maven-plugin/pom.xml](judo-tatami-jsl-workflow-maven-plugin/pom.xml): Maven Mojo plugin (`default-model-workflow` goal) that bridges Maven parameters to the workflow engine

## Modules — Testing

- [judo-tatami-jsl-workflow-maven-plugin-test/pom.xml](judo-tatami-jsl-workflow-maven-plugin-test/pom.xml): End-to-end integration tests for the Maven plugin

## Depends on

- [judo-meta-asm](../../models/judo-meta-asm): ASM metamodel — Ecore-based architecture model with builders and validation
- [judo-meta-expression](../../models/judo-meta-expression): Expression metamodel — type-safe numeric, string, temporal, and collection expressions
- [judo-meta-jql](../../models/judo-meta-jql): JQL metamodel — Xtext-based declarative query language
- [judo-meta-jsl](../../models/judo-meta-jsl): JSL language toolchain — grammar, parser, validator, code generator, and LSP servers
- [judo-meta-liquibase](../../models/judo-meta-liquibase): Liquibase database change management metamodel
- [judo-meta-psm](../../models/judo-meta-psm): PSM metamodel — foundational platform-specific data model
- [judo-meta-rdbms](../../models/judo-meta-rdbms): RDBMS schema metamodel with incremental evolution tracking
- [judo-meta-ui](../../models/judo-meta-ui): UI metamodel — pages, containers, tables, inputs, and data bindings
- [osgi-repackaged-bundles](../../packages/osgi-repackaged-bundles): Third-party libraries repackaged as OSGi bundles for Karaf
- [judo-dao-api](../judo-dao-api): Core DAO interfaces for CRUD, query, navigation, and validation
- [judo-dispatcher-api](../judo-dispatcher-api): Dispatcher API contracts for routing API calls to runtime actions
- [judo-operation-utils](../judo-operation-utils): Base classes and collection operations for generated operation scripts
- [judo-runtime-core](../judo-runtime-core): Multi-module runtime engine — data access, business logic, REST, and security
- [judo-sdk-common](../judo-sdk-common): Base classes for generated SDK — entity identity, DAO base, and query filters
- [judo-tatami-base](../judo-tatami-base): PSM transformation pipeline — models to schemas, expressions, and configurations
- [judo-tatami-core](../judo-tatami-core): EMF transformation trace tracking and composable workflow engine
- [judo-tatami-util](../judo-tatami-util): Utility facade for EMF model transformation traces
- [epsilon-runtime](../../tools/epsilon-runtime): Eclipse Epsilon runtime for Maven and OSGi environments

## Used by

- [community-documentation](../../community-documentation): Community-facing JUDO platform documentation
- [documentation](../../documentation): JUDO platform documentation
- [judo-runtime-core-jsl](../judo-runtime-core-jsl): JSL support for runtime core — model parsing through to DAOs and schema
- [judo-jsl-springboot-parent](../../spring/judo-jsl-springboot-parent): Parent POM for JUDO JSL Spring Boot applications
- [judo-spring-maven-plugin](../../spring/judo-spring-maven-plugin): Maven plugin transforming JSL models into Spring Boot application code
